name.zh: 一人公司 · 超级个体

description.zh: 一支替你运转「你自己」这家公司的 AI 幕僚班子：情报雷达盯风向、第二大脑攒认知、内容工坊做影响力、财富部门盯搞钱机会与账本、晨夕复盘管节奏与进化。直接跟公司负责人对话即可按需开关定制。
description.en: An AI team that runs your one-person company: Intel Radar for external signals, Second Brain for knowledge synthesis, Content Studio for multi-platform publishing, Wealth & Deals for revenue opportunities & ledger analysis, and Daily Patrol for morning briefings & nightly evolution.

zh: radar：零 Token 预检 + 行业热点、舆情与信息差盯盘
brain：消化随手投喂的笔记、长文与录音，构建个人认知网
studio：把外部情报与个人观点裂变为多平台待发成稿并呈批
wealth：盯搞钱痛点、套利线索与收支数据算账
daily-patrol：早 08:00 一页纸拍板早报 + 晚 21:00 复盘进化
en: radar: Zero-token preflight watch for industry signals & trends
brain: Second brain that digests notes, links & voice memos into reusable insights
studio: Multi-platform content production staged for one-click human approval
wealth: Opportunity hunting, deal evaluation & personal ledger analytics
daily-patrol: 08:00 executive morning brief & 21:00 nightly review

tasks.title: 碎片内化与常青认知卡合成
周度认知串联与思维底座进化
今日重点战役进度盯盘
早间一页纸拍板简报
晚间进度盘点与规则进化
专项情报深挖与竞品侦察
公开信源异动哨兵
社媒热点与跨网信息差巡检
母本打磨与多端精铸 (Multi-Channel Content Forge)
每日选题炼金会 (Daily Topic Pitch)
动态视频与演讲 Deck 精铸 (Motion Video Forge)
语感进化与手改学习 (Voice Calibration & Evolver)
浏览器自动对账与收支订阅审计
搞钱火花毒舌尽调与商务报价参谋
净值盘点与资产配置再平衡体检

description.zh: 一支替你持续维护开源软件的 AI 团队：有人盯 GitHub Issue 和构建报错、有人写代码、有人在真实桌面上做打包与界面测试、有人每天定时发版。内含实战项目 OpenCompare。
description.en: An AI team that maintains open-source software end to end: watching GitHub issues & CI, writing code, testing real desktop builds, and cutting daily releases. Includes OpenCompare as a live project.

zh: daily-patrol：每晚 21:00 盘点全团队进度，把踩坑经验写回共享规则
computer：需要使用真实电脑桌面点击操作时的公共执行通道
en: daily-patrol: 21:00 nightly progress review & shared lessons update
computer: Shared operator channel for real desktop GUI actions

tasks.title: 桌面系统图形界面操作
晚间进度盘点与经验总结

summary.zh: 配备 7 项日常值班任务：GitHub Issue 与构建报错盯盘、每日 07:00 定时发版、安装包启动自检、大文件夹性能测试、软件界面交互实测、桌面系统窗口实测、发版后自动回帖关单。
summary.en: Equipped with 7 standing shifts: GitHub issue & CI watch, 07:00 daily release, installer smoke check, large-folder stress test, UI interaction check, native window check, and post-release issue replies.
